messages:
izzy: New hire hit onboarding snag: ran mac pkg, then `redwoodctl login --local-serve` opened browser but CLI never received callback (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED).

noah: Ask which binary is running: `which -a redwoodctl` often reveals old copies.

izzy: Yup, an old /usr/local/bin/redwoodctl was shadowing the signed /opt/redwood/bin one. Removed the old binary, re-ran login and macOS showed firewall prompt. CLI printed: 

Error: listen EACCES: permission denied 0.0.0.0:8087

claire: Two small fixes: 1) CLI should detect EACCES on macOS and print a friendly hint to check Security & Privacy -> Firewall or re-allow the app after moving binaries; 2) installer postinstall should scan PATH for other redwoodctl instances and warn users.

noah: Also doc tweak: mention device-code fallback `REDWOODCTL_DEVICE_CODE=1` and `REDWOODCTL_NO_BROWSER=1` for WSL/CI/headless.

izzy: One more onboarding nit: sample app docs mention REDWOOD_API_URL but local-serve expects REDWOODCTL_API_URL. Can we accept REDWOOD_API_URL as an alias? Tripped up a few interns.

claire: Low-risk changes. I'll take the CLI error message and alias. noah, can you file the installer issue and a quickstart doc patch?

noah: Filed issue #1602 and added a tiny Quickstart note. doc-bot: created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/891 (quickstart update).

izzy: Thanks — flow worked after removing old binary and allowing firewall. Device-code saved another teammate on WSL. :thumbsup:
